description: Conecta Recife Wifi is a dataset listed in City of Recife open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Emprel. Contém as informações do programa Conecta Recife, que espalhou pontos de WIFI pela cidade, possibilitando o acesso de todos à internet de forma gratuita. Mais informações sobre o programa pode ser obtido no sitio. Coverage: Recife. The portal files it under the publisher Emprel. Its tags are Conecta, Conexão, Internet, WIFI. It offers 4 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal shows 2026-09-15 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licença Aberta para Bases de Dados (ODbL) do Open Data Commons. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-recife-portal.
